description: This Java source file defines a final utility class 'HeaderEntryFilters' which provides factory methods for creating various 'HeaderEntryFilter' instances. These filters are used to process headers based on policies such as whether to read/write headers externally, discard acknowledgement requests, and filter by header existence. The class is designed to be immutable and contains static methods only.

classes.name: HeaderEntryFilters
classes.description: A utility class providing factory methods to create HeaderEntryFilter instances for different header filtering policies.

methods.name: toExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter to exclude headers that should not be written to external headers and discard internal Ditto acknowledgment headers when applicable.

methods.name: fromExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter to only include headers that can be read from external headers, possibly filtering JSON array headers.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Creates a filter that only includes headers explicitly defined as HeaderDefinition.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinitionAndExternal
methods.description: Creates a filter that combines existence as a HeaderDefinition and the 'to external headers' policy.
